youtube.baslik: Without equipment, can the whispered voice test catch hearing loss? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: When no equipment is available, the whispered voice test can be used: the tester stands behind the person, masks the other ear and whispers numbers or letters. In a systematic review in adults, sensitivity was 90 to 100 percent and specificity 70 to 87 percent. But whisper intensity varies between testers, so the method is not standardized; screening audiometry is preferred when possible.
